merger_description:
VC Operations (WA) Pty Ltd, which is part of the Vets Central group of companies (**Vets Central**), proposes to acquire 100% of the business assets of Hills Veterinary Centre from veterinarian, Jonathan Julian Carruthers (the **Acquisition**).

Vets Central is an Australian owned veterinary group that owns and operates 78 first opinion veterinary practices across Australia, including Familypet Vet Coromandel Valley, which is located approximately 3.5 km from Hills Veterinary Centre. Vets Central’s practices provide core and ancillary veterinary services for household pets as well as livestock, and other exotic species. The services primarily include routine, planned, and emergency veterinary services (excluding after-hours services).

Hills Veterinary Centre is a full-service veterinary practice in Blackwood, South Australia. The business provides a range of first opinion core and ancillary veterinary services for household pets (extending to exotic pets) in the local area.

phase2_notice_matters_to_investigate.heading: Relevant areas of competition
items: How far pet owners in Blackwood and surrounding areas are willing to travel to purchase General Veterinary Services.

phase2_notice_matters_to_investigate.heading: Competitive effects in the supply of General Veterinary Services in the local Blackwood area
items: The extent to which other clinics providing General Veterinary Services located north of Hills Veterinary Centre would meaningfully constrain the merged entity in the local Blackwood area.

The likelihood of timely new entry and expansion that would constrain the merged entity in the supply of General Veterinary Services in the local Blackwood area, including the extent of attachment of senior vets to existing practices and the extent to which reputation influences customers’ choice of veterinary clinic.

The extent to which the Acquisition and acquisitions put into effect by Vets Central in the three years preceding notification have affected or would affect the competitive constraints faced by Vets Central in the suburbs around Blackwood.
